//: No hooks are active by default. The event contract these stand in for is documented in EVENTS.md (file-save / file-open / tab-change / graph-activity). To enable an example, move its block from '//examples' into 'hooks' and drop the '//' key. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} points at this plugin directory; $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is set by Claude Code. Ready-to-copy variants live in ./examples/.

post_write_index.//: file-save analogue: after Claude writes/edits, warm Tybre's search index for the project. Structured filter (--path-glob) keeps it to markdown.

post_bash_notify_graph.//: graph-activity analogue (XC-105/106 · TD-XA): after a Bash tool call whose command mentions `tybre ` or a `tybre://` link, publish a graph-activity event so the graph fires a neural particle. The Bash tool's JSON payload arrives on stdin; grep it for the marker and only then notify. Headless (app closed) is a silent no-op — `tybre notify-event` always exits 0, so it never fails the Bash call. The graph resolves --path to the acting project's uuid when --project is omitted.
